entities.name: Vehicle A
entities.identification: A box-shaped van in the right lane of the Two-lane highway, with a white upper section, a yellow lower section, and a dark rectangular rear window.

entities.name: Vehicle B
entities.identification: A light-colored compact passenger car in the left lane ahead of Vehicle A, with a dark rear window.

entities.name: Group of vehicles in the distance on the main road
entities.identification: A group of small vehicle silhouettes on the Two-lane highway, farther away than Vehicle B and near the vanishing point, excluding Vehicle A and Vehicle B.

entities.name: Two-lane highway
entities.identification: A dark asphalt straight road in the center of the image, with a yellow edge line on the image-left, a white edge line on the image-right, and a central dashed white line separating the two lanes.

entities.name: Sunset sky
entities.identification: An orange-pink sky with horizontal gray-purple cloud bands and a bright golden-yellow area on the image-right.

entities.name: Distant mountains on the horizon
entities.identification: Dark, low mountain silhouettes on the horizon, with a relatively gentle left section and distinctly undulating peaks in the right section.

entities.name: Group of vehicles on the parallel road on the left
entities.identification: A group of background vehicles on the Parallel road on the image-left, including a truck with a bright rectangular cargo box and points of light from vehicles farther away.

entities.name: Gravel and desert terrain on both sides of the highway
entities.identification: A gray gravel slope near the highway and yellow-brown dry ground beyond it.

entities.name: Dry grass and shrubs on both sides of the highway
entities.identification: Patches of yellow-brown dry grass and green low shrubs of varying sizes on both sides of the highway.

entities.name: Parallel road on the image-left
entities.identification: A gray paved road strip to the left of the Two-lane highway, with desert terrain separating the two roads; this road gradually converges into the distance.
